annotations.title: Get a monitored competitor URL's change timeline

description: Timeline of DETECTED changes for one monitored competitor URL, newest first — a check that found nothing does not appear here. Each entry's summary is a real diff: line-level content added/removed/unchanged counts with a short sample (never a fabricated similarity score), plus title/meta/status-code before-after values and added/removed external links and structured-data types.

limit.description: Max entries to return. Defaults to 50, capped at 200.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

targetId.description: Monitored URL's target ID, from list_competitor_monitors or add_competitor_monitor.

name: get_competitor_monitor_changes
